english_baseline_construction: For each held-out task/model/target, read transfer_lang=eng from data/<held_out_task>_<model>.csv; inherit the cross-task artifact oracle and metric metadata; restrict all methods in the with-English variant to the same English-supported targets.
raw_gap_note: Raw oracle gaps are comparable within a held-out task. Cross-task averages combine heterogeneous task-metric point scales and should be treated as secondary descriptive results.
